description: This file is a C header defining the interface for hiredis, a Redis client library. It includes macros, data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to Redis connection management, command formatting, and reply handling.

methods.name: redisReaderCreate
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new redisReader object for parsing Redis protocol replies.

methods.name: freeReplyObject
methods.description: Frees a reply object returned by hiredis.

methods.name: redisvFormatCommand
methods.description: Formats a Redis command string using a printf-style format and va_list arguments.

methods.name: redisFormatCommand
methods.description: Formats a Redis command string using a printf-style format.

methods.name: redisFormatCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a Redis command string from argument vector.

methods.name: redisFormatSdsCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a Redis command into an sds string from argument vector.

methods.name: redisFreeCommand
methods.description: Frees a command string allocated by hiredis.

methods.name: redisFreeSdsCommand
methods.description: Frees an sds command string.

methods.name: redisConnect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to Redis server via TCP.

methods.name: redisConnectWithTimeout
methods.description: Establishes a TCP connection to Redis with a specified timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectNonBlock
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking TCP connection to Redis.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlock
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking TCP connection with source address binding.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlockWithReuse
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking TCP connection with source address binding and address reuse.

methods.name: redisConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to Redis via Unix socket.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixWithTimeout
methods.description: Connects to Redis Unix socket with timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixNonBlock
methods.description: Establishes a non-blocking Unix socket connection.

methods.name: redisConnectFd
methods.description: Creates a Redis context from an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: redisReconnect
methods.description: Reconnects using saved connection parameters.

methods.name: redisSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets the timeout for a Redis connection.

methods.name: redisEnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive on the connection.

methods.name: redisFree
methods.description: Frees a Redis context.

methods.name: redisFreeKeepFd
methods.description: Frees a Redis context and keeps the file descriptor open.

methods.name: redisBufferRead
methods.description: Reads data from Redis socket into buffer.

methods.name: redisBufferWrite
methods.description: Writes data from buffer to Redis socket.

methods.name: redisGetReply
methods.description: Retrieves a reply from Redis server.

methods.name: redisGetReplyFromReader
methods.description: Retrieves a reply using the protocol reader.

methods.name: redisAppendFormattedCommand
methods.description: Appends a formatted command to the output buffer.

methods.name: redisvAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command with va_list arguments.

methods.name: redisAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command with printf-style formatting.

methods.name: redisAppendCommandArgv
methods.description: Appends a command from argument vector.

methods.name: redisvCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with va_list arguments and returns reply.

methods.name: redisCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with printf-style formatting and returns reply.

methods.name: redisCommandArgv
methods.description: Sends a command from argument vector and returns reply.
